description: Pronoun-heavy prose where some pronouns resolve fine within a short range and others require material that has been removed; tests that a pronoun alone is not automatically disqualifying.
sourceText: She had waited for years before she finally understood what he meant by that remark. He never explained it directly, and she never asked him to. What she came to realize, on her own, was this: patience often teaches us more than the thing we were waiting for ever could. It was a lesson she carried with her long after he was gone, repeating it quietly to herself on difficult days, though few who knew her ever heard her say it aloud.
